_comment: Lab 4 — dashboard as code. Portable Grafana definition; import it, or translate the panels to CloudWatch / Azure Monitor / Cloud Monitoring. Committing the dashboard is better than clicking one together, and is noted favourably.
title: ITCS355 — Prediction service

panels.title: Error rate by class
panels._note: Share of all requests that were 4xx or 5xx. `on() group_left` is needed: the numerator has a status_class label, the denominator has none, so a plain division matches nothing.

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels._note: If p99 is far above p95 in a repeating pattern, suspect cold start or a per-request model load.

panels.title: Feature drift (PSI per feature, latest scheduled check)
panels._note: Written by monitoring/drift.py (--pushgateway locally, --emit to Azure Monitor in CI). Alert threshold is in reports/drift_threshold.json.

panels.title: Model version in production
panels._note: Shows the version label itself (the metric value is always 1).

panels.title: Input rolling mean: temp_c (last 500 requests)
panels._note: Feature-distribution statistic computed inside the service over a rolling window. One feature, because features with very different scales cannot share an axis.
